reviewer: stress-test review pass (Kimi Code), rubric METHODOLOGY.md sections 7-8

default_rules.distinctiveness: 3 if the premise's mechanism signature is unique in the raw pool, 2 if it is a kept member of a signature cluster, 1 for rejected
default_rules.character_comedy_strength: 3 if comedy_is_character_based and the mechanism is engine-signature (forecast_irony, feelings_visible, dignity_maintenance, hiding_mistake, fomo, imitation_flattery, misplaced_helpfulness, trying_to_impress, social_embarrassment) or the premise is contradiction-driven; 2 if otherwise character-based; 1 if comedy is physics-only
default_rules.emotional_clarity: 3 if stakes_type is feelings or relationship; otherwise 2; rejected may score 1
default_rules.rewatch_support: 3 for ids in rewatch3 (verifiable/countable on screen or continuity-planting), otherwise 2; rejected may score 1
